senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) fish. ד׳ טמא unclean fish, forbidden in dietary laws, ד׳ טהור clean, permitted.
units: M. Kat. 25ᵇ דְּגֵי רקק, v. לִוְיָתָן.—מַזַּל דָּגִים (or without מזל) The Fishes, Pisces, twelfth sign of the Zodiac.
